title: Switching codes
statement: For a width $w$ and a natural number $m$, a switching code of index $m$ is defined inductively as follows. At index $k+1$, it is either a canonical block code whose position set has size $k+1$, or a choice of $i<k$, a canonical nonzero block code whose position set has size $i+1$, and a switching code of index $k-i$.
hypotheses_covered: The code index is a natural number
The recursive block is canonical, nonzero, and has $i+1$ positions
